message.text:
I am looking for where memo derived metadata is computed, what triggers recomputation, and what properties are extracted.

The metadata likely comes from memo payloads with tags, properties, and mentions extracted during markdown processing. I will trace this in the codebase.

Tracing memo metadata recomputation triggers. CreateMemo and UpdateMemo appear to drive recalculation when content changes. memopayload RunOnce exists but is not wired in production.

RebuildMemoPayload computes MemoPayload.tags and MemoPayload.property from content, not user input. Mentions may be extracted but are likely not stored in the payload. I still need to verify whether tags are user-set or derived, and check the update path in memo_service.go.

Confirmed: MemoPayload has no mentions field, so ExtractAll does not store mentions in the payload. Now examining the memo_service update path for contentUpdate and mention triggers.

Derived metadata is stored in MemoPayload, specifically tags and properties.

RebuildMemoPayload is the computation site. It calls markdown ExtractAll. CreateMemo always triggers it. UpdateMemo triggers it only when the update mask path is "content". memopayload.Runner.RunOnce performs batch rebuilds. It is not wired into server startup. Extracted properties include tags, has_link, has_code, has_task_list, has_incomplete_tasks, and title. Title comes from the first H1.

Mentions are extracted by ExtractAll but handled separately for notification targets. User-set location is stored independently of the payload.

h14.

**computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) → `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`); **triggers:** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask; **extracted properties:** `#tags` → `payload.tags`; links/code/task lists/H1 title → `payload.property` (`has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`)

Derived metadata lives in `MemoPayload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`): `tags` and `property` are computed from markdown; `location` is user-provided and not part of this path.

**Computation site**

`RebuildMemoPayload` calls `ExtractAll` and writes into the memo payload:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

`ExtractAll` parses markdown once and walks the AST (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-421`).

**Triggers (recomputation)**

| Operation | File | When |
|-----------|------|------|
| **CreateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` | Always, before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **UpdateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451` | Only when update mask includes `"content"` |

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` also rebuilds all memos in batches (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-71`), but it is not started from `server/server.go`, so it is not part of normal runtime.

Updates to visibility, location, attachments, etc. do not re-run `RebuildMemoPayload` unless `content` changes.

**Extracted properties**

From `ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`), persisted via `RebuildMemoPayload`:

- **`payload.tags`** — `#tag` tokens (custom tag extension; deduplicated)
- **`payload.property`** (`proto/store/memo.proto:15-22`):
  - `has_link` — any link node
  - `has_code` — code block, fenced block, or inline code
  - `has_task_list` — task checkbox nodes
  - `has_incomplete_tasks` — unchecked task checkbox
  - `title` — text of the first top-level H1 heading

`ExtractAll` also collects `@mentions`, but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not store them in the payload; mentions are used at notification time via `resolveMentionTargets` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`).
